summary: File reviewed: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-sjj-Documents-claude-projects/6c815da4-1bbb-46e2-ab32-dd34a7cc22c1/scratchpad/design/final_program.json. MECHANICAL RESULTS: every exercise_id in weekly_template resolves to an exercises[] entry (0 missing); block minutes sum exactly to duration_min on every day (48/47/49/48/48/50/0, all within 40-50); every advance_when carries an x2/x3/terminal/count condition; every gate reference (exercise_id.step >= n) points to an existing ladder and n <= max step (no dangling or circular gate). Ladders do start low for a smaller beginner: wall push-up, chair sit-to-stand, 8 lb half-kneeling press, 12 lb row/goblet/RDL, 20 lb then 35 lb dumbbell swings before the bell, naked/shoe get-up. 19 ladder targets fall outside the declared target grammar (warmup '6 min', cooldown 'prescribed min', prone_ytw 'each letter', neck 'each direction'/'each', hinge/swing 'SxR checklist 5/5' written as one token instead of joined with ' + ', TGU '0 drops' and 'in <= 10:00'). WHY REFUTED: (1) The week-4 Boss Battle sends two people who under the program's own gates have never been allowed to jog (intervals locked at brisk-walk step 1-2 through week 4) into an all-out 1-mile run, and asks a user still on swing step 1-2 (hike-and-park / dead-stop only) to do a 5-minute max continuous-swing test; both are exactly the gate violations the design says it prevents. (2) The Saturday swing block prescribes continuous swings (8 per odd minute EMOM) to users on swing steps 1-2, before continuous swings are earned at step 3; and Saturday is undefined for steps 6, 7 and 12. (3) swing step 1's requirement (hinge_deadlift.step >= 3) sits in a 'how' string that the data model only evaluates at advance time, so it is either never enforced (day-1 hike with no hinge competency) or, if enforced, leaves Thursday's primary block and Saturday's swing block with no defined fallback for weeks 1-2 (up to week 5). (4) hinge_deadlift is trained once per week (Mon, 3 sets) yet gates the bell, rows, carries, shrugs, SL RDL and calf steps; simulated with perfect performance under the x2 / one-advance-per-session / no-advance-in-weeks-4-8-12 rules, a user placed at hinge step 1 reaches step 5 in week 10 and never reaches step 6, so the BELL GATE is unreachable in 12 weeks for that user and lands in week 10-11 in the best case. Phase 2's '53 lb bell in swing', Phase 3's S&S density clock, Boss Battle 2 warrior/champion tiers and the 'both earning the bell' duo badge are therefore unreachable or nearly so for both users. (5) No on-ramp: day 1 is 19 performed working sets (Mon) and 28 (Tue) for people with no training in 6 months and <10 push-ups; 18 pressing sets vs 12 pull sets per week; triceps get 18 loaded sets/week from zero. (6) The interval ladder's own 'running minutes rise <= 10%/week' rule is violated by its steps (8 -> 10 min = +25%, 7.5 -> 12 min = +60%). (7) Three 53 lb ladder steps (goblet_squat 8, calf_raise 6, hip_thrust 6) carry no hinge gate in the JSON even though safety text claims one for calf and hip thrust and the 53 lb goblet requires picking the bell off the floor to the chest. Volume per muscle is otherwise sane for beginners (glutes 28, triceps 18, hamstrings 15, core 14, shoulders 13, quads 10, chest 9, back 9, calves 3 sets/week; swing volume 57-107 DB swings/week at steps 1-5, 130-150 bell swings/week at steps 8-11), lower body sits on Mon/Thu/Sat with 48 h gaps, and Sunday is a true rest day; the fixes below are targeted and do not require restructuring the split.

issues.issue: Week-4 (and week-8) Boss Battle 3 requires a 1-mile treadmill run 'as fast as possible' from users the RUN GATE has never cleared to jog.
issues.evidence: safety_and_form_gates rule 5: intervals locked at brisk-walk step 1 until treadmill_zone2.step >= 2 and 2 weeks elapsed; jogging only at treadmill_intervals step 3. Simulation (Sat only, x2, no advance in week 4): step 2 earliest week 2 Sat, step 3 earliest week 5. So at the week-4 test nobody has been allowed to jog, yet bb_mile_time says '1.00 mile as fast as possible, walk/run mix allowed' with tiers rewarding sub-8:00. Also the health-screen 'yes' lock covers intervals only, not the mile or swing tests.
issues.fix: Add a gate to bb_mile_time: if treadmill_intervals.step < 3 the test is 'fastest 1-mile WALK, max belt 4.5 mph, no jogging' with its own tier table (e.g. recruit >18:00, soldier 15:00-18:00, warrior 13:00-15:00, champion <13:00) and tier cap; running mile only from intervals.step >= 3, and cap week-8 pace at the step-4 run speed (6.5 mph). Extend the health-screen lock to bb_mile_time and bb_swings_5min. Schedule the mile on a separate day (Sunday) for the second user since one treadmill cannot host two 13-min tests inside a 48-min script.

issues.issue: Boss Battle 2 (5-minute max swings) is administered to users whose swing ladder step (1 = hike-and-park, 2 = dead-stop single swings) does not permit continuous swings.
issues.evidence: bb_swings_5min: 'Two-hand swings ... any rest scheme, 5-min cap ... Implement = the user's current swing ladder implement: 20 lb DB'. Placement quiz: 'swing always 1'. Swing step 3 is the first step allowing 'Continuous two-hand DB swing'. Simulation: with Thu-only counting, step 3 is reached week 5; even counting Saturday, step 3 arrives week 2 Sat. At the week-4 test a user placed at hinge step 1 (swing locked until hinge >= 3, week 5) has done zero continuous swings. The test also comes fourth, after max goblet squats and max hollow hold, i.e. max-effort hinging on a pre-fatigued trunk.
issues.fix: Gate the test on swing.step >= 3: below that, score 'locked' (0 tier points, shown as a lock with the remaining condition) or count dead-stop singles for 3 min at swing.step == 2 with tier capped at recruit. Reorder the script so swings precede goblet squats (mile, 8 min walk, push-ups, hollow, swings, goblet, step-ups), or split the Boss Battle across Saturday (mile, push-ups, hollow) and Sunday/next Wednesday (swings, goblet, step-ups) so no more than three max tests share a day.

issues.issue: Saturday swing block prescribes continuous swings to users on swing steps 1-2, before continuous swings are earned at step 3; Saturday prescriptions for swing steps 6, 7 and 12 are undefined.
issues.evidence: weekly_template Sat strength B: 'steps 1-5: 8-min EMOM of 8 DB swings odd minutes / 8 goblet squats even minutes'. swing ladder: step 1 'No swing yet', step 2 'Hike, one swing to chest height, park', step 3 'Continuous ... Sets of 10'. conditioning_protocols.swing_engine defines Saturday only for steps 1-5, 8 and 9-11; nothing for step 6 (dead-stop 53 lb), step 7 (continuous 53 lb 5x10) or step 12 (one-hand).
issues.fix: Split the Saturday rule by step: steps 1-2 -> 8-min EMOM of 5 hike-and-park (step 1) or 5 dead-stop DB swings (step 2) on odd minutes / 8 goblet squats on even minutes; steps 3-5 -> current text; steps 6-7 -> 8-min EMOM of 5 dead-stop (6) or 8 continuous (7) 53 lb swings odd minutes / 8 goblet squats even minutes; step 8 -> 8x10 EMOM; steps 9-11 -> density clock; step 12 -> 10-min EMOM 5+5 one-hand. State explicitly whether a Saturday log counts toward the swing x2 counter (recommend: only when Saturday's sets meet the ladder target).

issues.issue: swing step 1's gate (hinge_deadlift.step >= 3) is never evaluated by the data model as written, or if it is, the template has no fallback for a locked swing in weeks 1-2 (up to week 5).
issues.evidence: progression_rules: 'Gate expressions ... are booleans the app evaluates at advance time'. swing step 1 'how': 'Requires hinge_deadlift.step >= 3'; placement quiz: 'swing always 1', so no advance ever enters step 1 and the gate is never checked -> both users hike a 20 lb dumbbell between their legs on Thursday of week 1 regardless of hinge competency, contradicting safety rule 1 ('Swings start at hike-and-park ... once hinge_deadlift.step >= 3'). If instead the app locks swing, Thu strength A (5 sets) and Sat strength B (12 min) have no defined content: rule 10's fallback list covers 'swing steps 1-5 use the dumbbell' but not a fully locked swing. Placement gives hinge step 1 or 2, so hinge >= 3 arrives week 2 (best) or week 5 (worst).
issues.fix: Move the gate into a machine-checkable field on the step (e.g. 'requires': 'hinge_deadlift.step >= 3') and state that requires-fields on the current step are evaluated every session, not only at advance. Define the locked-swing fallback in the template: Thu strength A slot 1 = hinge_deadlift (3 sets at current step) + 2 sets glute_bridge; Sat swing block = 8-min EMOM of 8 wall hinges/12 lb RDLs odd minutes / 8 goblet squats even minutes. Loosen the entry gate to hinge_deadlift.step >= 2 (12 lb RDL with checklist) since a 20 lb hike-and-park is lighter than the step-3 RDL.

issues.issue: hinge_deadlift is trained once per week (Mon, 3 sets) yet is the master gate for the bell, rows, carries, shrugs, SL RDL and calf raise; under the program's own advance rules the BELL GATE is unreachable in 12 weeks for a user placed at hinge step 1 and lands only in week 10-11 in the best case.
issues.evidence: Simulated with perfect performance, x2 consecutive sessions, one advance per session, no advances in weeks 4/8/12: hinge from step 1 -> step 2 wk2, 3 wk5, 4 wk7, 5 wk10, step 6 never; from step 2 -> 3 wk2, 4 wk5, 5 wk7, 6 wk10. BELL GATE (swing step 5 advance_when) needs hinge_deadlift.step >= 6 AND hollow_hold.step >= 4 (wk3) AND swing 5x15 x2 (Thu-only: step 5 reached wk10, met x2 wk11). So the 53 lb bell is first swung in week 11 at best and never for the hinge-step-1 user. Phase 2 goal text promises '53 lb bell in deadlift/swing/goblet/row as gates pass' (weeks 5-8); Phase 3 promises S&S density clock and one-hand swings; bb_swings_5min warrior/champion tiers require the 53 lb bell; duo badge 'both earning the bell'. Also 'Q8 yes ... allows the BELL GATE checklist sessions to count from day 1' has no machine-checkable meaning.
issues.fix: Train hinge_deadlift twice weekly: add it to Thu strength A ahead of the swing (3 sets; while swing is locked it fills the swing slot as above) and let Saturday's warm-up hike-and-park sets count for the swing checklist but not the ladder. Let deload-week sessions increment the x2 counters (advance applied on the first non-deload session) instead of freezing them. Relax the bell gate to hinge_deadlift.step >= 5 x2 (the 53 lb deadlift itself, which is the HINGE GATE) rather than >= 6, since step 6 is a high-rep variant of the same lift. Re-simulate and rewrite Phase 2/3 goals and the Boss Battle 2 tiers to match the earliest realistic bell week; delete or define the Q8 'count from day 1' clause.

issues.issue: No on-ramp: week 1 starts at full template volume for two people with no training in 6 months, and the upper days are press-heavy.
issues.evidence: Performed working sets per day (each-side sets counted per side, computed from the template): Mon 19, Tue 28, Wed 21, Thu 20, Fri 27, Sat 14 (~130/week plus 20 min intervals and ~65 min Zone 2). Weekly bilateral-equivalent sets: triceps 18 (push_up 4, diamond 2, OHP 3, floor press 3, pike 3, triceps ext 3), 18 pressing sets vs 12 horizontal-pull/rear-delt sets. Tue day 1 = 4 push-up + 2 diamond + 6 OHP sides + 6 row sides + 3 lateral + 3 curl + 3 carries + neck = 28 sets in ~37 min. The program acknowledges 'Expect DOMS in weeks 1-2' but provides only a reactive auto-deload. Tendon adaptation lags muscle by weeks; elbow (lateral/medial epicondyle) and anterior-shoulder overuse is the classic week-2-3 dropout cause on 6-day beginner plans.
issues.fix: Apply the existing deload multiplier as an on-ramp: weeks 1-2 = strength sets x0.6 (round down, min 2), RIR 3-4; week 3 full. Cut diamond_push_up from Tue to Fri (replacing db_triceps_extension) or drop db_triceps_extension in Phase 1 so triceps land at ~14 sets. Add a second pull to Tue (prone_ytw 2 sets or a 3-set db_row at step -1) to bring pull to >= 15 sets/week. Keep week-1 Tuesday under 22 performed sets.

issues.issue: The interval ladder violates its own 'running minutes never rise more than 10% week to week' rule and step 6 doubles hard-interval duration.
issues.evidence: treadmill_intervals: step 3 = 8 x 1 min jog = 8 min; step 4 = 10 x 1 min run = 10 min (+25%); step 5 = 10 x 45 s = 7.5 min; step 6 = 4 x 3 min = 12 min (+60% and 3-min hard reps for a first-year runner who is also doing 3 lower-body days). safety rule 5 and interval_engine.progression: 'running minutes rise <= 10%/week'. No pain-flag condition on step 4 -> 5 or 5 -> 6 (only 'completed x2').
issues.fix: Reshape steps so hard-run minutes go 8 -> 9 -> 10 -> 11: step 3 = 8 x (1/1) jog, step 4 = 9 x (1/1) run, step 5 = 10 x (1/1) run at RPE 9, step 6 = 5 x (2 min hard / 2 min easy) = 10 min; add 'no shin/knee/Achilles pain flag in 14 days' to every advance_when from step 3 up; encode the 10% rule as a machine check (hard_minutes(step+1) <= 1.1 x hard_minutes(step)).

issues.issue: Three 53 lb ladder steps carry no hinge gate in the JSON, contradicting safety rule 3 and leaving the heaviest floor-to-chest pickup ungated.
issues.evidence: safety_and_form_gates rule 3: 'any 53 lb step in rows, shrugs, carries, SL RDL, calf, hip thrust requires hinge_deadlift.step >= 5'. In the ladders, db_row 6, db_shrug 5, suitcase_carry 4, farmer_carry 4 and single_leg_rdl 7 state the requirement, but calf_raise step 6 ('Single-leg + 53 lb KB') and hip_thrust step 6 ('Hip thrust + 53 lb KB') do not. goblet_squat step 8 ('53 lb KB goblet, bell by the horns'), split_squat step 8 and step_up step 6 ('or 53 lb goblet') require lifting the bell from the floor to the chest (a hinge + curl) with no gate at all; for a 120 lb user that is 44% BW cleaned to the sternum each set.
issues.fix: Add 'requires hinge_deadlift.step >= 5' (as a machine-checkable field) to calf_raise 6, hip_thrust 6, goblet_squat 8, split_squat 8 and step_up 6, and add a coaching cue on goblet_squat 8: 'deadlift the bell to the knees, then curl it to the chest with both hands; never swing it up'.

issues.issue: Large load jumps on single-arm overhead pressing and lateral raises for a smaller user, and a dynamic push press introduced as the bridge to 35 lb.
issues.evidence: db_overhead_press: step 4 = 12 lb standing tempo/1.5-rep 3x8-12 -> step 5 = 20 lb strict 3x6-10 each side (+67%); step 6 = 20 lb tempo 3x12-15 -> step 7 = 35 lb PUSH press 3x5-8 each side (+75%, and the first dynamic overhead movement in the ladder). For a 120-130 lb user a 35 lb single-arm press is ~27% BW, an intermediate standard. db_lateral_raise step 5 (12 lb 1.5-rep) -> step 6 (20 lb single-arm lean-away, +67%) on an isolation lift. db_floor_press 20 -> 35 (+75%) is bridged by only one tempo step.
issues.fix: Insert bridging rungs: OHP step 4b '12 lb standing press, 3x15-20, last set RIR 0'; OHP step 6b '20 lb press + 2 s hold at lockout, 3x15'; make 35 lb strict press (current step 8) precede the push press, or replace the push press with '35 lb press, two-hand assist on the way up, 3 s single-arm lower' (eccentric-only) as the bridge. Lateral raise step 6 -> '12 lb raise, 3x20 + 10 partials' with the 20 lb lean-away as an optional terminal for users >= 180 lb. Floor press: add '20 lb 1.5-rep press 3x12-15' between steps 4 and 5.

issues.issue: Two users, one treadmill: the Wednesday 32-min Zone-2 block and the Saturday 20-min interval block cannot be completed by both users in the same 45-50 min window, and no non-treadmill Zone-2 fallback exists.
issues.evidence: weekly_template Wed: warm-up 3 min + conditioning 32 min on treadmill_zone2 = 35 min per user; Sat treadmill_intervals 20 min per user plus 4-min flush. risks_and_mitigations only offers a 'swap order' toggle for strength A/B blocks (8 min TGU + 4 min finisher on Wed, i.e. nothing to swap into). Exercise list has no bodyweight Zone-2 alternative, so the second user's Zone-2 minutes silently vanish from the AHA tally.
issues.fix: Add exercise_id 'march_step_zone2' (chair step-up march / stair walking / brisk march in place at talk-test pace, target 'N min RPE <= 4') as the machine-selectable fallback when the treadmill is in use, and add a per-user 'treadmill window' offset in settings so Wed/Sat sessions are staggered by 35/20 min. Note in the plan that Wednesday is the one day the couple trains at different times if they refuse the fallback.

issues.issue: Several blocks cannot fit their allotted minutes at the prescribed sets and rests, which pushes users to cut rest on hinge-heavy work.
issues.evidence: Wed strength B: 4 sets x 1 get-up each side = 8 get-ups (~35 s each at step 1-2) + 7 x 45 s rest = ~10 min against an 8-min block. Sat finisher: 2 hollow (30 s + 20 s), 2 plank_side_plank sets each = plank + 2 side planks + 3 rests (~165 s per set), 2 leg raise (~60 s) = ~9 min against 7 min. Tue finisher: 3 farmer carries 40 s + 40 s rest (4 min) + neck 4 x 10-20 s = 5-5.5 min against 5 min. The time guard 'drops the last strength-B set and trims cooldown', so the get-up (the skill that must 'never be rushed') is what gets cut.
issues.fix: Wed: 3 get-ups each side (6 total) with 30 s rest, or extend the block to 10 min by shortening Zone 2 to 30 min in every phase. Sat finisher: make plank_side_plank 1 set on Saturday (it is already 1 set on Wed) and keep hollow 2 / leg raise 2, or extend to 9 min by trimming intervals' walk-out to 1 min. Add 'never drop the get-up' to the time-guard rule.

issues.issue: Machine-checkability gaps: 19 targets fall outside the declared grammar, some advance conditions and quiz outcomes have no data field, and a timed lock lives only in prose.
issues.evidence: Targets not matching progression_rules grammar: warmup_flow '6 min', cooldown_flow 'prescribed min', prone_ytw 1-4 'each letter', neck_isometrics 1-4 'each direction'/'each', hinge_deadlift 1 & 5 and swing 1, 2, 6 '5x5 checklist 5/5' (single token; grammar says compound targets are joined with ' + '), turkish_get_up 1 'checklist 3/3' (same), 2 '0 drops', 7 '5x1 each side in <= 10:00'. hollow_hold step 1 advance 'with back flat' references no checklist in its target. treadmill_intervals step 1 'how' says 'and 2 weeks elapsed' but advance_when has no elapsed-time clause. Placement Q7 'no -> treadmill_zone2 1 at 20 min building to 30' has no ladder step (step 1 target is '30 min RPE <= 4'). turkish_get_up step 7 advance_when is just 'x3 (terminal)'.
issues.fix: Rewrite targets in grammar: '3x10 + checklist 5/5', '4x1 each side + checklist 3/3', '4x1 each side + 0 drops' (add 'drops <= n' to the grammar), '5x1 each side + 10:00 clock' (add 'N:SS clock'), prone_ytw '3x10 each letter' -> add 'each letter' as an allowed suffix or expand to three parts; neck 'each direction' likewise. Add 'weeks_elapsed >= 2' to intervals step 1 advance_when. Add treadmill_zone2 step 0 '3.0 mph, 0-2%, 20 min RPE <= 4, advance x2'. Give hollow_hold step 1 a 'checklist 1/1' (back flat). Make TGU 7 advance_when '5x1 each side in <= 10:00 x3 (terminal)'.

issues.issue: Calves are trained once per week despite the claim that every visible muscle is hit twice; front-of-shin (tibialis) has zero work while the plan ramps incline walking and running.
issues.evidence: why_this_gets_results_fast: 'chest, back, shoulders, arms, glutes, quads, hamstrings, calves and core each hit twice weekly'. calf_raise appears only Mon (3 sets); no tibialis or ankle work anywhere; interval ladder adds hill walking at 8-12% and running by step 3; risks list names 'knee/shin overuse'.
issues.fix: Add calf_raise 2 sets to Thu strength B (after step_up) and 2 x 20 wall tibialis raises (bodyweight, heels 12 in from wall) to the lower-day warm-up flow or the Sat finisher; correct the frequency claim if not.

issues.issue: Chair-height Bulgarian split squats and step-ups are prescribed at full seat height regardless of user stature.
issues.evidence: step_up step 2 'Chair step-up (bodyweight) full seat height'; split_squat step 4 'Rear foot on chair'. Settings capture seat height but no rule uses it. A standard 18 in seat puts the knee above the hip for a user under ~5 ft 4 in, loading the lumbar spine and hip flexor at end range on every rep.
issues.fix: Use the onboarding seat-height value: if seat height > 0.28 x user height (about knee height), prescribe the couch cushion/stair (8-12 in) for step-ups and a cushion or stacked books for the Bulgarian rear foot; store the effective height per user and show it on the card.
